figures.heading: Staff list
figures.alt: Staff list in production, scrolled to the last columns
captions: Billable is the last column. There is no Technician column and no notice.

figures.heading: Notice and Technician column
figures.alt: Staff list with the notice and the Technician column
captions: Notice, verbatim: "New: Decide who appears on Board View, Tech View and the technician dropdowns. Turn Technician on or off for each person in their staff settings, next to Sales Representative. To start, it is on for everyone who worked on a work order in the last 90 days, is on open work, or is billable."
No close button: it disappears for everyone on the "New" pill's end date.

Technician column, read-only and sortable, just left of Billable: Yes when the person's Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on, otherwise No. A deactivated person always shows No. It changes only through the staff window (page 2).
"New" pill at the top right of the Technician header. It goes away at 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships this; the exact date is set when the release is scheduled.

TurnOn.dc.html.title: 2. Turn Technician on for a staff member

figures.heading: New Staff Member
figures.alt: New Staff Member window in production
captions: Time Clock and Sales Representative sit beside Billable. No Technician toggle.

figures.heading: New Staff Member
figures.alt: New Staff Member window with the Technician toggle off
captions: The three toggles move to one row of their own below Billable, the same row as Edit: Time Clock, Sales Representative, Technician. Nothing else moves.
Technician is last, with the "New" pill (same end date as the staff list pill). The window opens with no role and Time Clock off, so Technician starts off and grayed out.

figures.heading: Technician role picked
figures.alt: New Staff Member with Time Clock on and the Technician role picked, Technician switched on
captions: Time Clock on and the built-in Technician role picked: Technician switches on by itself. The built-in Foreman role does the same; every other role, including Parts Technician and custom roles, leaves it off.
Changing the role or Time Clock sets it again from the role, until the user switches Technician by hand: from then on their choice wins. Edit Staff Member never does this.

figures.heading: Edit Staff Member
figures.alt: Edit Staff Member for Olivia Garrett in production
captions: Time Clock on, so today she is offered as a technician everywhere (pages 5 and 6), with no way to say otherwise.

figures.heading: Technician off
figures.alt: Edit Staff Member with Technician off
captions: Technician is off: on release day it was turned on only for people who, in the last 90 days, had time on a work order, lead or are on a line of an open work order, or are billable. She was none of those.

figures.heading: Switched on
figures.alt: Technician switched on, not saved yet
captions: Switched on, not saved yet. Nothing changes until Save & Close. Turning it on never shows a warning and never logs her out.

figures.heading: Saved
figures.alt: Staff list filtered to Parts Manager, Technician Yes
captions: The staff list, filtered to Parts Manager, now shows Technician Yes. Billable stays No: Technician never changes Billable.

Any other role, including a custom role copied from either one, never grays it out.

figures.heading: Lead Technician

captions: Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. Add Labor uses the same list.
Anyone already on a line who is not a technician any more stays on it and shows grayed out, the same as a deactivated technician today.
